description: This file contains a suite of shell functions and test cases for verifying the behavior of the 'git check-ignore' command. It includes setup procedures, various test scenarios, and supporting utility functions to validate ignore patterns, submodule handling, symlinks, and input/output streams in the context of Git's ignore system.

methods.name: init_vars
methods.description: Initializes variables used for test configurations.

methods.name: enable_global_excludes
methods.description: Enables global ignore file by configuring core.excludesFile.

methods.name: expect_in
methods.description: Sets expected output in a file, used for assertions.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Wraps expect_in for standard output expectations.

methods.name: expect_from_stdin
methods.description: Saves stdin input to a file for comparison.

methods.name: test_stderr
methods.description: Checks that stderr contains expected output.

methods.name: broken_c_unquote
methods.description: Processes text to simulate C-style string unquoting.

methods.name: stderr_contains
methods.description: Ensures stderr output includes a given regex pattern.

methods.name: stderr_empty_on_success
methods.description: Checks that stderr is empty when expected, based on exit code.

methods.name: test_check_ignore
methods.description: Runs 'git check-ignore' with specified arguments and verifies the result.

methods.name: test_expect_success_multiple
methods.description: Runs multiple test scenarios with different verbosity and index options.

methods.name: test_expect_success_multi
methods.description: Wrapper for multiple scenario tests with --index.

methods.name: test_expect_success_no_index_multi
methods.description: Wrapper for multiple scenario tests with --no-index.
